title: Practice 5: об-: around — из-: all over

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Обычай ___ (исходить, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) из Китая.
exercises.why: **исходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of исходить: imperfective.  Prefix **из-, изо-, ис-**: movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Мы ___ (обежать / обегать, past pl.) вокруг парка.
exercises.why: **обежали** — past tense (plural) of обежать: perfective (imperfective partner: обегать).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: От шара ___ (исходить, pf., past n. sg.) какое-то странное свечение.
exercises.why: **исходило** — past tense (neuter) of исходить: imperfective.  Prefix **из-, изо-, ис-**: movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: From the sphere emanated some kind of strange glow.

exercises.q: Осень, и с деревьев ___ (облетать / облететь, 3rd pl.) листья.
exercises.why: **облетают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of облетать: imperfective (perfective partner: облететь).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: It's autumn and the leaves are falling from the trees.

exercises.q: Том ___ (обвести / обводить, past m. sg.) в кружок три имени в списке.
exercises.why: **обвёл** — past tense (masculine) of обвести: perfective (imperfective partner: обводить).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: Tom circled three names on the list.

exercises.q: Тома ___ (обвести / обводить, past pl.) вокруг пальца нигерийские аферисты.
exercises.why: **обвели** — past tense (plural) of обвести: perfective (imperfective partner: обводить).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: Tom was scammed by Nigerian scammers.

exercises.q: Интервью было снято на видео и затем ___ (облететь / облетать, past n. sg.) весь Интернет.
exercises.why: **облетело** — past tense (neuter) of облететь: perfective (imperfective partner: облетать).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: The interview was recorded on video and shared all over the Internet.

exercises.q: Ты по чину ___ (обносить / обнести — to enclose; imper. sg.)!
exercises.why: **обноси** — imperative (ты, singular) of обносить: imperfective (perfective partner: обнести).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
